features.name: Portfolio Diversification Index
features.description: Measures cross-sectional dispersion of daily dollar-volume-adjusted returns across the portfolio using a rolling 20-day window. Higher values indicate greater concentration in specific stocks.
procedure: Sort each stock's data by date ascending
Compute daily dollar volume (div_adj_close * volume) for each stock
Calculate rolling 20-day standard deviation of normalized returns (div_adj_close return / portfolio median return) per stock
Aggregate cross-sectional standard deviation of these values across all stocks on the same date using equal weights
If fewer than 50% of stocks have valid data, set value to NaN
features.interpretation: High values indicate poor diversification with extreme return dispersion; low values suggest uniform risk distribution across stocks

features.name: Market Leadership Concentration Score
features.description: Calculates the cumulative contribution of top 10% highest dollar-volume stocks to total portfolio return over 60-day window
procedure: Sort each stock's data by date ascending
Compute daily dollar volume (div_adj_close * volume) for each stock
For each date, identify top 10% of stocks by current dollar volume
Calculate cumulative return contribution of these stocks to total portfolio return over 60-day window
Normalize by total portfolio return and cap at 1.0
features.interpretation: Values near 1.0 indicate performance dominated by a few large-cap stocks; lower values suggest broad-based participation

features.name: Momentum Shift Frequency
features.description: Counts the number of sign changes in rolling 20-day momentum (div_adj_close return) across all stocks on each date
procedure: Sort each stock's data by date ascending
Calculate daily div_adj_close returns for each stock
Compute rolling 20-day momentum (sum of returns) per stock
Count how many stocks changed sign from positive to negative or vice versa compared to previous day
Normalize by total number of stocks with valid data
features.interpretation: High values indicate frequent momentum regime shifts; low values suggest stable directional trends

features.name: Volatility Regime Stability
features.description: Measures consistency of rolling 60-day volatility (standard deviation of div_adj_close returns) across the portfolio
procedure: Sort each stock's data by date ascending
Calculate daily div_adj_close returns for each stock
Compute rolling 60-day volatility (standard deviation) per stock
Aggregate cross-sectional standard deviation of these volatilities across all stocks on the same date using equal weights
Normalize by portfolio median volatility
features.interpretation: High values indicate unstable volatility patterns; low values suggest consistent clustering behavior

features.name: Portfolio Regime Transition Frequency
features.description: Counts transitions between bull/bear regimes defined by cumulative div_adj_close returns over 60-day window
procedure: Sort each stock's data by date ascending
Calculate daily div_adj_close returns for each stock
Compute rolling 60-day cumulative return per stock
Identify regime changes (crossing +5% or -5% thresholds) compared to previous day
Normalize count by total number of stocks with valid data
features.interpretation: High values indicate frequent market state transitions; low values suggest prolonged regime persistence

features.name: Systematic Risk Amplification Index
features.description: Measures correlation between individual stock returns and portfolio-wide return (internal benchmark) over rolling 60-day window
procedure: Sort each stock's data by date ascending
Calculate daily div_adj_close returns for each stock
Compute equal-weighted portfolio return as average of all stocks' returns on same date
Calculate rolling 60-day correlation between each stock's return and portfolio return
Aggregate cross-sectional average of these correlations using equal weights
features.interpretation: High positive values indicate strong systematic risk alignment; low values suggest idiosyncratic behavior

features.name: Recovery Velocity Index
features.description: Measures time-to-recover from drawdowns using cumulative div_adj_close returns over 60-day window
procedure: Sort each stock's data by date ascending
Calculate daily div_adj_close returns for each stock
Compute rolling 60-day cumulative return per stock
For each drawdown event, measure days to recover to previous peak
Aggregate cross-sectional median recovery time across all stocks on same date
features.interpretation: Lower values indicate faster recovery from losses; higher values suggest persistent drawdowns

features.name: Liquidity Correlation Intensity
features.description: Measures synchronization of dollar-volume changes across stocks using rolling 20-day window
procedure: Sort each stock's data by date ascending
Compute daily dollar volume (div_adj_close * volume) for each stock
Calculate rolling 20-day percentage change in dollar volume per stock
Aggregate cross-sectional standard deviation of these changes across all stocks on same date using equal weights
Normalize by portfolio median volume change volatility
features.interpretation: High values indicate synchronized liquidity shocks; low values suggest independent trading activity

features.name: Sentiment Coherence Score
features.description: Measures alignment between individual stock returns and portfolio-wide return (internal benchmark) over rolling 60-day window
procedure: Sort each stock's data by date ascending
Calculate daily div_adj_close returns for each stock
Compute equal-weighted portfolio return as average of all stocks' returns on same date
Calculate rolling 60-day correlation between each stock's return and portfolio return
Aggregate cross-sectional standard deviation of these correlations using equal weights
features.interpretation: High values indicate divergent behavior from internal benchmark; low values suggest coherent movement

features.name: Risk Contribution Uniformity Index
features.description: Measures standard deviation of individual stock contributions to portfolio volatility over rolling 60-day window
procedure: Sort each stock's data by date ascending
Calculate daily div_adj_close returns for each stock
Compute rolling 60-day volatility (standard deviation) per stock
Aggregate cross-sectional standard deviation of these volatilities across all stocks on same date using equal weights
Normalize by portfolio median volatility
features.interpretation: High values indicate uneven risk distribution; low values suggest uniform contribution patterns

features.name: Portfolio Regime Adaptability Index
features.description: Measures difference in cumulative returns between high and low volatility periods over rolling 60-day window
procedure: Sort each stock's data by date ascending
Calculate daily div_adj_close returns for each stock
Compute rolling 60-day cumulative return per stock
Identify periods where volatility (std dev of returns) is above/below median
Aggregate cross-sectional difference in average returns between these periods using equal weights
features.interpretation: High positive values indicate better performance during high volatility; negative values suggest underperformance

features.name: Information Flow Dominance Metric
features.description: Measures ratio of absolute return to dollar volume as proxy for information-driven trading activity
procedure: Sort each stock's data by date ascending
Calculate daily div_adj_close returns and dollar volume (div_adj_close * volume) per stock
Compute ratio of absolute return to dollar volume for each stock
Aggregate cross-sectional standard deviation of these ratios across all stocks on same date using equal weights
Normalize by portfolio median ratio
features.interpretation: High values indicate returns are driven more by information flow than liquidity; low values suggest noise dominance

features.name: Dynamic Correlation Stability
features.description: Measures consistency of pairwise stock correlations over rolling 60-day window
procedure: Sort each stock's data by date ascending
Calculate daily div_adj_close returns for each stock
Compute rolling 60-day correlation matrix between all pairs of stocks
Aggregate cross-sectional standard deviation of these correlations using equal weights
Normalize by portfolio median correlation
features.interpretation: High values indicate unstable inter-stock relationships; low values suggest persistent correlations

features.name: Tail Risk Exposure Concentration
features.description: Measures contribution of top 10% highest dollar-volume stocks to maximum drawdowns over rolling 60-day window
procedure: Sort each stock's data by date ascending
Compute daily dollar volume (div_adj_close * volume) for each stock
For each date, identify top 10% of stocks by current dollar volume
Calculate cumulative drawdown contribution of these stocks to portfolio max drawdown over 60-day window
Normalize by total portfolio drawdown
features.interpretation: High values indicate tail risk concentrated in large-cap stocks; low values suggest diversified exposure

features.name: Portfolio Entropy of Returns
features.description: Calculates Shannon entropy of daily div_adj_close returns across the portfolio over rolling 60-day window
procedure: Sort each stock's data by date ascending
Calculate daily div_adj_close returns for each stock
Compute rolling 60-day distribution of returns per stock
Aggregate cross-sectional Shannon entropy across all stocks on same date using equal weights
Normalize by maximum possible entropy value
features.interpretation: High values indicate chaotic, unpredictable return patterns; low values suggest structured behavior
